subject: Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: Numerical Involvement has a strong_positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: NI-001 worsened the measured time outcomes rather than improving them.
evidence: NI-001 attributable throughput worsened by +41.534 hours per case, z=73.75
NI-001 intake waiting worsened, z=71.14
NI-001 intake duration worsened, z=10.00
contradictions.note: Revise the time impact away from strong_positive; the evidence supports a negative direction for this measured configuration.

subject: Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: Numerical Involvement has a strong positive impact on time.
contradictions.measured_said: NI-001 hurt the plan: its sole-footprint intake activity had significantly worse waiting, contrary to the predicted time improvement.
evidence: NI-001 intake waiting rose with z=+8.27
NI-001 was attributed a hurt verdict
the measured note reports a +41.534 h/case worsening
contradictions.note: The measured self-contention contradicts the strong-positive time direction; the prior should be revised rather than retained.

subject: Exception
contradictions.prior_said: Exception handling has a weak positive impact on time by isolating slower exceptional cases.
contradictions.measured_said: EXC-001 helped throughput and reduced attributable diagnosis 2nd activity time.
evidence: EXC-001 was measured as helped
diagnosis 2nd attributable activity time fell with z=-32.98
contradictions.note: The available attribution supports the time direction, but shared effects prevent a stronger update to the full Exception vector.

subject: Extra Resources
contradictions.prior_said: Extra Resources have a strong positive impact on time by reducing contention and queueing.
contradictions.measured_said: Retaining XR-001 helped; removing it in the confirmation run made throughput and waiting significantly worse.
evidence: XR-001 was measured as helped
the confirmation plan comparison became significantly worse without XR-001
XR-001 targeted a 0.95 contention ratio with waiting comprising 68.73% of activity time
contradictions.note: The plan comparison supports the prior's time direction, although no standalone z-score was supplied for the confirmation contrast.

subject: Numerical Involvement
contradictions.prior_said: Numerical Involvement strongly improves time and weakly improves cost.
contradictions.measured_said: NI-001 worsened waiting, duration, and attributable throughput; its attributed cost also increased.
evidence: NI-001 waiting worsened with z=57.81
NI-001 duration worsened with z=116.25
NI-001 attributable throughput worsened by 6.6979 h/case
Round-2 attributable cost increased by 0.0292 h/case
contradictions.note: The measured direction contradicts the prior's positive time and cost effects; flexibility and quality remain untested.

subject: Case Types
contradictions.prior_said: Case Types strongly improves time by routing cases according to their characteristics.
contradictions.measured_said: CT-001 improved waiting and throughput while duration and resources remained flat.
evidence: CT-001 waiting improved with z=-29.09
CT-001 attributable throughput improved by 11.8039 h/case
Phase-3 built CT-001 successfully
contradictions.note: The measured time direction supports the prior, although the cost and flexibility components were not tested.
